<thought>Based on the 13C NMR data the molecule contains one carbonyl carbon (≈168 ppm), two sp² carbons (≈144 ppm and 130 ppm) and three methyl carbons (≈22, 21 and 19 ppm). The fragments that can be assembled to give the whole structure are therefore a carbonyl fragment, an alkene fragment and three methyl fragments. Their SMILES strings are: carbonyl = "C(=O)", alkene = "C=C", and each methyl = "C".</thought>
<final_answer>['C(=O)', 'C=C', 'C', 'C', 'C']</final_answer>
